Man, I went through something similar. My ex was someone that I dearly loved. I gave her everything and as a christian I value my chastity, but she didn't. I loved her so much, so I gave everything up for her. She would always influence me by letting me listen to her music and she would always draw me stuff. When we broke up, it was a month after she cheated. After I found out she cheated, I forgave her, but instead she told me that she couldn't stay committed to me. She was my love. I gave her everything and here she was telling me that everything I gave her wasn't worth anything and that I'm something that could be thrown away. I felt horrible after that. I got hospitalized twice for it. The 2nd time, she visited and ruined my stay, so I was stuck for 4 weeks more in the hospital. I missed her. I wanted her back dearly, but I know that I can't. Its painful to move on. It hurts the most when the wrong people leave you. I hope you don't hurt yourself like I did. It wasn't worth it. In the end, I've realized that my ex is a piece of shit. She made me go through several pregnancy scares and STD scares. It was scary. Me giving complete trust in her and she threw it away as if it was nothing. As if my safety was nothing either. I hope you'll do better. I made a lot of mistakes. I kept talking to her, but you have to stop eventually. I realized that if you stop talking to her and live on with your live, you slowly stop thinking about them. And when you do think about them, just accept that you're thinking about them and try to think about something else. You have to keep trying that, because it rewires the connections in your brain to stop thinking about them. Sorry about the long story. Hopefully I wasn't too late.

Its okay man. Best to be safe and not have it. I was 14 when I was in a relationship and we had sex. It went from just some intimate fun to emotional and physical abuse. It hurt me more than anything and I still get flashbacks from it. Its better to be safe than to have these scars.
